scene_description: A woman and a young girl are outside at a table covered with a Halloween spider-web tablecloth, carving pumpkins together. There are multiple orange pumpkins on the table, one already partially carved with a face. The girl is touching a large uncarved pumpkin. Fall leaves are visible in the corner of the image.
